## Loading necessary packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

## Reading in the Data

```{r}
urban <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-09-22/urban.csv')
```

## Cleaning

```{r}
urban_clean <- 
  urban |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    avg_per
  )
```

## Q1: Which city has the most green area per capita in each year?

```{r}
urban_cities <- urban_clean |>
    select(
      city_name,
      green_area_per_capita_m2) |>
  arrange(desc(green_area_per_capita_m2))
  
head(urban_cities)
```

```{r}
urban_countries <- urban_clean |>
    filter(year == 1990) |>
    group_by(country_or_territory_name)
  
head(urban_countries)
```

```{r}
 countries_urban <-urban_clean |> 
  group_by(country_or_territory_name)
```
